privacySections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use this website or contact us, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We aim to collect as little as possible and to be clear about how it is used.

privacySections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you submit the contact or consultation forms, we collect the details you provide — such as your name, business email, company, phone number, project type, budget range and message.

Like most websites, our hosting and analytics may automatically record limited technical data such as IP address, browser type and pages visited, used only to keep the site secure and to understand aggregate usage.

privacySections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the information you send to respond to your enquiry, to prepare for a consultation, and to follow up on a potential engagement. We do not sell your information, and we do not share it except with service providers who help us operate the site and communicate with you.

privacySections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep enquiry information for as long as needed to respond and, where relevant, for the duration of an engagement and a reasonable period afterwards. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

privacySections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise any of these, contact us using the details below.

privacySections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this policy or how your information is handled, please get in touch using the contact details on this site.

termsSections.heading: Acceptance of terms
paragraphs: By accessing and using this website, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.

termsSections.heading: Use of the site
paragraphs: You may use this website for lawful purposes only. You agree not to misuse the site, interfere with its normal operation, or attempt to access it in any way other than through the interface we provide.

termsSections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The content, design and code of this website are owned by us or our licensors and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Case-study material describing client work is used with permission where required.

termsSections.heading: No warranties
paragraphs: The site is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. While we work to keep the information accurate and the site available, we make no warranties of any kind about its completeness, reliability or fitness for a particular purpose.

termsSections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we will not be liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from your use of, or inability to use, this website.

termsSections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
